object.attr: derived: an issue tag can be moved or re-created and a revision label is free text, so a PDF that names only them can't be checked later; MELLON-VER-SRS-67 decided the same for Compare. A repository with no commit added (review Q38). Accepted only together with MELLON-PDF-SRS-90, since a real hash on uncommitted text gives false assurance (review Q63, decided on 2026-11-11).
object.description: The cover page shall show the exported commit by at least the first 7 hexadecimal digits of the commit's hash, or state that the repository has no commit.
